text:
Situation: Morphine sulfate injection has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2017-10-31 and remains current as of 2026-10-21, spanning 108 months. Corvale East holds 11 days on hand, Corvale General 19 days, and Corvale Lakeside 22 days at current usage. Specific product days range from 2.7 to 27.4 days across sites. An approved therapeutic interchange for the same product from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC 63323045201, 2 mg/mL) was authorized by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2025-10-09 and requires pharmacist substitution.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2017-10-31. The Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plant (FEI 3001833549) received an OAI classification letter dated 2017-12-28, 58 days after the initial posting. That plant had prior OAI inspections ending 2011-07-08 and 2013-01-11, with a Warning Letter issued 2012-02-22. Its most recent inspection ended 2023-10-13 and was classified VAI. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 2220525) is also listed as a current shortage manufacturer; its latest inspection ended 2024-06-12 and was classified VAI.

Our position: Inventory is critically low at Corvale East for several presentations. The approved interchange from Fresenius Kabi is the primary mitigation. Alternative suppliers are not on the FDA shortage list but their manufacturing sites are unverified.

Recommended actions:
1. Activate the approved therapeutic interchange to Fresenius Kabi product (NDC 63323045201) — requires pharmacist execution per protocol approved by Casey Nguyen, MD.
2. Place orders with Civica, Inc. for morphine sulfate injection — requires buyer approval and P&T committee review of supply reliability.
3. Place orders with MDD US Operations, LLC for morphine sulfate injection — requires buyer approval and P&T committee review of supply reliability.
4. Place orders with TruPharma, LLC for morphine sulfate injection — requires buyer approval and P&T committee review of supply reliability.

Not recommended: Switching to any alternative product not yet reviewed by the committee; relying solely on current inventory without activating the approved interchange; purchasing from unverified manufacturers without site qualification.
